title: SAML: A fractal of bad design
summary: Trail of Bits published a critical analysis of SAML (Security Assertion Markup Language), examining why the XML-based authentication standard is fundamentally flawed in its design, with issues spanning complexity, security vulnerabilities, and poor implementation patterns.
problem_solved: Explains why SAML has been a source of security vulnerabilities and implementation difficulties despite being widely adopted for enterprise SSO.
why_valuable: Helps security engineers and developers understand the inherent flaws in SAML to make informed decisions about authentication architecture and potentially migrate to more secure alternatives like OAuth/OIDC.
